Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: preserve backups + keystore handback for impending DPA exit

Rafael,

We are preparing for our contract transition window and need Redwood to temporarily preserve certain backups and provide a keystore handback process while we complete an internal forensic review. Per our DPA (section 5.2), we're requesting the following:

- Short-term retention of snapshots for the Acme Health tenant for 21 days beyond the planned deletion cutover.
- A signed manifest listing keystore identifiers and export hashes; a secure transfer method for the keystore material.
- Confirmation of where archived logs will be stored and the purge timeline.

Can you confirm if Redwood can: (1) approve a 21-day hold instead of immediate purge, (2) provide an HSM-backed keystore export workflow (handback), and (3) supply SOC 2 evidence for the backup custody during the hold?

Attached is our retention request form (acme_retention_request_form.pdf) and a short draft of the DPA amendment we intend to sign if you can accommodate. We appreciate a proposed timeline today so we can align internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Marta Velasquez
Senior Counsel, Acme Health
legal@acmehealth.com

--

Subject: Re: Request: preserve backups + keystore handback for impending DPA exit

Thanks Marta — we can support this but need to coordinate legal, security and ops steps. Proposed internal plan below (high level):

1) Short-term snapshot hold: ops will mark the tenant snapshots for a 21-day retention beyond cutover. During this hold snapshots remain immutable and access-audited.

2) Keystore handback: security will prepare an export manifest referencing KMS key IDs; we cannot export private HSM keys directly, but we can create an encrypted export package (AES-256) and share via the secure SFTP escrow agreed in the DPA addendum. Handback requires an authorized legal sign-off and completion of the keystore transfer checklist.

3) Evidence & controls: we will provide SOC 2 relevant artifacts (access logs, key access events, snapshot checksums) as redacted PDFs to the Acme legal and ForensicAudit under an NDA addendum if required.

4) Purge schedule: automated purge job will be paused for 21 days; after the hold expiry we will run the scheduled purge and provide a deletion certificate.

Action items for us: Kim, can you draft the DPA amendment (DocuSign link) and confirm the legal signatory? Connor, can you confirm ops can tag the snapshots this morning and produce the manifest by EOD?

I have attached the DPA amendment draft we received as a starting point (dpa_amendment_draft_v2.pdf).

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Marta,
I've attached a redline of the DPA with a narrow amendment to permit a temporary 21-day hold and an escrow-based keystore export. A few notes:

- We can accept 21 days, not longer, without a formal enterprise SLA amendment. If Acme requires longer we need an approved procurement amendment.
- For the keystore: Redwood will provide an encrypted keystore export package; Acme must confirm the recipient public key for transfer and complete the keystore acceptance checklist. Full HSM private keys cannot be handed over; we use an encrypted export with integrity hashes.
- Forensic access: we will provide access logs and a custody manifest. We cannot provide raw production logs; we will provide redacted exports necessary for the forensic review.

Please review the attached redline (dpa_amendment_draft_v2.pdf) and confirm a signatory for DocuSign. If acceptable, I will issue the DocuSign envelope and loop Security for the export process.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
